title: 2 BR 1 Bath Bungalow in Green Hills, Nashville TN
description:
Located in green hills-just a short drive to everywhere you want to go-centrally located. Relaxed & comfortable home w/2 bedrooms (one w/a full bed & other w/a queen bed). Bathroom in b/w the 2 bedrooms. Galley kitchen w/sit in breakfast nook. Lg den w/big TV. nice dining rm: seats 6-8. Front porch w/bench & comfortable chairs. Local channels and Netflix on TVs. This is our primary residence.

The space
Very safe neighborhood. House has a circle driveway with plenty of space for parking directly outside the front door. Lots of natural light throughout the home. Tankless water heater (endless hot water!) and great water pressure. Beds are very comfortable. There is a very nice park that is a 1-2 minute walk from the home (one house between park and our home). All closets will be locked as this is our primary personalized cozy residence. Guests will have use of two downstairs bedrooms, one downstairs bathroom, dining room, den, kitchen and all outdoor spaces. This is an older home (built in 1937!) that was remodeled in 2011. Pets welcome for a $30/Pet/day additional fee. There is a fenced in backyard and doggie door to the basement for dogs to access during the time that you’re away during your stay. Children’s toys and pack n play available for guests use. Infant bathtub available upon request. Whole house water filtration system.

Guest access
Guests will have access to entire downstairs with the exception of all closets. The den, dining room, kitchen, two bedrooms, one bath, front yard, and backyard are all yours! The upstairs is the owners bedroom and there is a door to the upstairs that will be locked. Owners will not be onsite during your stay.

Other things to note
Spacious southern living with covered front porch. Beautiful landscaping and cutting gardens. Very nice neighbors. 5 minutes from the interstates. Guests will have use of entire downstairs of home. Door to upstairs will be locked. This is owners primary residence. WiFi works great. Den and bedrooms have TVs with local channels and Netflix/YouTube TV.  Circle driveway in front of home. Great park with play sets and walking path very close to home - a one minute walk (There is only one house in between this home and the park!)
